statement: You are given an integer array nums, whose elements may be negative, and an integer k.

A subarray is a non-empty run of adjacent elements. Return how many subarrays have elements adding up to exactly k. Subarrays at different positions are counted separately even if they hold the same values.

examples.explanation: [1, 1] at indices 0 to 1 and [1, 1] at indices 1 to 2 both sum to 2.
Eight subarrays sum to 3, among them [1, 2], [3], [1, 1, 1] and [4, 2, -3]. The negative values let some longer ones, such as [1, 2, 3, -3], reach 3 as well.
